items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: did I tell you that I worked with Tony Jackson

ctx.x: This is a list of all the records you've made. This -- it's called a discography. Now, tell me something.
Excuse me, but did I tell you that I worked with Tony Jackson, a fellow that wrote 'Pretty Baby'?
No, you didn't tell me that.

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: So that's where I worked with Tony e X Jackson, who was a marvelous pianist.

ctx.x: I conned him out of it, you know. So that's where I worked with Tony e X Jackson, who was a marvelous pianist. Marvelous pianist. And wrote some wonderful songs. He wrote, "Your Time Now is Going to Be Mine Some Sweet Day." He wrote, "Pretty Baby". He wrote -- oh, I can't remember all the songs.
